source: SSC 2026 CCM version, TABLE 1 'Table of Statements', pdf p3-10 / journal p727-734
extraction_method: visual reading — Table 1 is embedded as page images, not extractable text
confidence_note: Section boundaries and 2021-STATEMENT blocks are large and unambiguous. The small ⊕ certainty symbols and ↖/↘ arrows were read at limited resolution and should be spot-checked.

domain_boundaries._comment: Taken from the coloured section headers inside Table 1. These differ from the Executive Summary's per-domain counts at one boundary — see discrepancies below.

discrepancies_vs_executive_summary.effect_on_our_table: statement 16 (antimicrobials within 1 h for septic shock) had been labelled screening; Table 1 places it in INFECTION. Corrected.
discrepancies_vs_executive_summary.reading: Both are defensible — 'give antibiotics within 1 h' is arguably early management. Table 1's section header is what we follow, because that is what a reader of the guideline sees.

discrepancies_vs_executive_summary.table1: merged into one section 'ADDITIONAL AND ADJUNCTIVE THERAPIES', statements 79-99 (21)
discrepancies_vs_executive_summary.effect_on_our_table: totals agree; the internal boundary (we assumed 79-86 / 87-99) cannot be verified from Table 1 and is marked unverified.

multi_grading_statements._comment: Statements the panel counts once but which carry more than one strength/certainty pair. This is the source of the +/-1 differences against the Executive Summary tallies.
27: 2021 version split into a high-risk and a low-risk statement

statement_53_certainty.narrative_text: Dopamine. High-certainty evidence / Epinephrine. Low certainty evidence / Selepressin. Low certainty evidence
statement_53_certainty.table1_symbols_as_read: Dopamine ⊕⊕⊕⊕ high / Epinephrine ⊕○○○ very low / Selepressin ⊕○○○ very low
statement_53_certainty.kept_in_table: the narrative text values (high / low / low)
statement_53_certainty.action: needs a human to look at journal p730 and settle it

notable: Statement 41 (selective digestive decontamination) is the only conditional recommendation at HIGH certainty (⊕⊕⊕⊕).
Statement 48's 2021 counterpart was itself an 'insufficient evidence' statement — the 2026 version upgrades it to a graded recommendation.
Statement 59 carries an 'In our practice' remark reporting panel behaviour (69% never use methylene blue) — a statement type with no evidence grade at all.
